The parser reads bold, italic,          
underlined, verbatim, code and struck   
text. Links look like the Org site      
(https://orgmode.org) or plain          
https://example.com, and a line ends    
here                                    
on purpose.

        7 with a counter                
 • [-] Wide characters: 漢字 and emoji
